questions.q_en: A train 900 m long is running at 108 km/h. How long will it take to clear a 900 m long platform completely?
questions.solution_en:
Speed of train = 108 km/h = 108 * 5/18 = 30 m/s

Time taken by train to cross a platform of length 900 m = (900 + 900)/30

= 1800/30

= 60 s

questions.q_en: Two pipes A and B can fill a tank in 25 minutes and 20 minutes respectively. If both pipes are opened together and A is closed after 5 minutes then how many minutes will B take to fill the remaining tank?
questions.solution_en:
Part filled by pipe A in 1 minute = 1/25

Part filled by pipe B in 1 minute = 1/20

Part filled by pipe A and B together in 1 minute = 1/25 + 1/20 = 9/100

Part filled by pipe A and B together in 5 minutes = 45/100

Remaining part = 1 - 45/100 = 55/100

Therefore, time taken by pipe B to fill the remaining part of tank = 20 x (55/100) = 11 minutes

questions.q_en: A family's average milk consumption for the first six months of the year is 30 L per month. In each of the next three months, consumption increases by 20% over the previous month. What must their consumption in the tenth month be so that the overall ten‐month average is 35 L?
questions.solution_en:
Let consumption in the tenth month be a L

Sum for first six months = 6*30 = 180 L

Each of months 7 - 9 = 30 X 120% = 36 L; sum = 3*36 = 108 L

Total for ten months = 10·35 = 350 L

So, 180 + 108 + a = 350

=> a = 350 - 288

=> a = 62 L

questions.q_en: Find the perimeter of a right angled triangle whose hypotenuse is 6 meters more than twice the shortest side and the third side is 4 meters more than twice the shortest side.
questions.solution_en:
Let shortest side = x

Hypotenuse = 2x + 6

And third side = 2x + 4

(2x+6)2 = (2x+4)2 + x2

36 + 24x = x2 + 16 + 16x

x2 - 8x - 20 = 0

=> x = 10

Perimeter = x + 2x + 6 + 2x + 4 = 5x + 10 = 5*10 + 10 = 60

Volume of cylinder = π * (radius of cylinder)2 * height of cylinder

Volume of C1 = π * (radius of C1)2 * height of C1

= π * ((2/3) *radius of C2)2 * height of C1

= (4/9) * π * (radius of C2)2 * height of C1

Volume of C2 = π * (radius of C2)2 * height of C2

Then, 3: 8 = ((4/9) * π * (radius of C2)2 * height of C1): (π * (radius of C2)2 * height of C2)

(Height of C2): (Height of C1) = 32: 27

questions.q_en: Mohit invested total of Rs.36000 in two different schemes A and B for 3 years. Scheme A offers 40% rate of simple interest while the scheme B offers 20% compound rate of interest. Amount of interest received from scheme B is Rs.180 more than that received from scheme A, then amount invested in scheme B is how much more than that invested in scheme A?
questions.solution_en:
Let amount invested in scheme A and B is (36000 - 100x) and '100x' respectively.

Interest from scheme A = [{(36000 - 100x) * 40 * 3}/100] = (43200 - 120x)

Interest from scheme B = 100x * [(1.2)3 - 1] = 72.8x

According to the question:

72.8x - (43200 - 120x) = 180

192.8x = 43380

x = 225

Amount invested in scheme A = 36000 - 100x = Rs.13500

Amount invested in scheme B = 100x = Rs.22500

Required difference = 22500 - 13500 = Rs.9000

Largest 4 - digit number = 9999

LCM of 5, 6 and 7 = 210

Common remainder = (5 - 1) = (6 - 2) = (7 - 3) = 4

Remainder when 9999 divided by 210 = 129

Required number = 9999 - 129 - 4 = 9866

questions.q_en: Pipe A can fill a pool in 36 minutes, Pipe B can fill in 48 minutes, and Pipe C can empty the full pool in 360 minutes. If A is opened alone for 10 minutes, and then B and C are opened together (with A closed), how many more minutes are required to fill the pool completely?
questions.solution_en:
Rate of pipe A = 1/36 units/minute

Rate of pipe B = 1/48 units/minute

Rate of pipe C = - 1/360 units/minute

Work by A in first 10 minutes = 10 X (1/36) = 10/36 = 5/18 units

Remaining = 1 - 5/18 = 13/18 units

Now A closes; B + C open: combined rate = 1/48 - 1/360 = 13/720 units/minute

Time to finish = (13/18) ÷ (13/720) = (13/18) X (720/13) = 720/18 = 40 minutes

y = tanA - sinA -------(2)

Multiplying eqn(1) and (2) -

xy = (tanA + sinA)(tanA - sinA)

xy = tan2A - sin2A

xy = sin2A/cos2A - sin2A*cos2A/cos2A

xy = (sin2A/cos2A)(1 - cos2A)

xy = tan2Asin2A

x2 - y2 = (x + y)(x - y)

= (tanA + sinA + tanA - sinA)( tanA + sinA - tanA + sinA)

= 4tanAsinA

= 4√(xy)
